<!-- prose:start -->
### Purpose

Verify every AI candidate (or engine finding when AI is OFF) against the compiled evidence registry and pack vocabulary; annotate failures, never remove artifacts. Deterministic post-AI validation — evidence grounding of candidates/findings.

### Context

- **Domain:** ADR-0010: flag-and-show semantics keep the human gate sovereign (ADR-0006). Checks are registry/pack lookups only — no model calls.
- **Jurisdiction:** Vocabulary membership is judged against the selected pack.
- **Project:** Operates on candidates/findings present in shared state.

### Contract

- **Population:** candidate findings when present (AI on); engine deterministic findings otherwise (AI off — baseline audited by the same rules).
- **Checks:** cited evidence_id exists in the compiled registry; each asserted quote matches the registry record's quote under whitespace normalization; and, for the candidate population only, category/road_users membership in the pack vocabulary (engine finding categories are the engine's own taxonomy, not bounded by CandidateVocabulary).
- **Failure mode:** annotate-and-continue — items are annotated with validation:{status:"auto-flagged", reasons[]} and never removed; the audit is never blocked.

### Verification

- ADR-0010 behavior tests cover unknown-evidence-id, quote-mismatch and vocabulary-membership flags with AI off and on.
<!-- prose:end -->
